question: What claim about the agency behind the yoginī named Icchā is at stake in stating that she extends to the end of Māyā by the supreme will of the siddhas?
premises: The yoginī named Icchā is posited.
She extends to the end of Māyā.
This extension occurs by the supreme will of the siddhas.
inference: The yoginī Icchā is presented as extending to the end of Māyā through the supreme will of the siddhas.
plain_english: The yoginī named Icchā, by the supreme will of the siddhas, extends to the end of Māyā.
